# Parameters (tag this cell as "parameters" in Synapse)
STORAGE_ACCOUNT = None                              # optional override; leave None to auto-detect
STAGING_DIR     = "OUTPUT/TRANSFORM/latest"         # transform outputs to scan for user names
ENTRA_FILE      = "INPUT/ENTRA/entraid_users.json"  # written by S62A_Raw_EntraID pipeline
REFERENCE_DIR   = "INPUT/REFERENCE"                 # users.csv lands here for the schema notebook
OUTPUT_DIR      = "OUTPUT/USERS"

# Staging columns that hold people's names. Unknown columns are ignored, so list both old and new names.
USER_COLUMNS = [
    # inspectors
    "Inspector", "Inspector / Planning Offcier", "Appointed Person",
    "inspector1Id", "inspector2Id", "inspector3Id",
    # assessors (no source column yet, add the real name once known)
    "Assessor", "Assessor Inspector", "assessorInspectorId",
    # case officers
    "Case Officer", "caseOfficerId",
    # planning officers
    "Planning Officer", "Case Administrator", "planningOfficerId",
    # readers (no source column yet)
    "Reader", "readerId",
]

# Names that won't match automatically (initials, nicknames, typos): {spreadsheet name: UPN or email}
NAME_OVERRIDES = {
    # "MB": "mark.boulton@planninginspectorate.gov.uk",
}

# Entra filtering
INTERNAL_DOMAIN        = "@planninginspectorate.gov.uk"  # drops guests (#EXT#) and pinso365 admin/PADS accounts
REQUIRE_EMPLOYEE_ID    = True    # drops shared mailboxes, call queues, test accounts
MATCH_DELETED_ACCOUNTS = False   # True = leavers (DELETED_ accounts) can match; False = leavers become name-only

# No Entra match: True = put the source name in idpUserId, False = put it in legacyId
UNMATCHED_NAME_IN_IDP = True

MIGRATION_USER_UPN = None   # UPN of the account used as author of migrated notes

# Environment resolution
import re
from notebookutils import mssparkutils

ACCOUNTS = {
    "dev":  "pinssts62adevukseftlkl",
    "test": "pinssts62atestuksnkavj4",
    "prod": "pinssts62aproduksrz8i4g",
}

ws = mssparkutils.env.getWorkspaceName().lower()
m  = re.search(r"(?:^|[-_])(dev|test|prod)(?:[-_]|$)", ws)
if not m:
    raise ValueError(f"Can't detect env from workspace name '{ws}'")
ENV  = m.group(1)
ROOT = f"abfss://s62a@{STORAGE_ACCOUNT or ACCOUNTS[ENV]}.dfs.core.windows.net/PIPELINE"
print(f"ENV={ENV} | ROOT={ROOT}")

# Load Entra users
import pandas as pd

raw = spark.read.option("multiLine", True).json(f"{ROOT}/{ENTRA_FILE}")
if "value" in raw.columns:                     # Graph pages land as {"value": [...]} objects
    raw = raw.selectExpr("explode(value) AS u").select("u.*")

entra_all = raw.select("id", "displayName", "givenName", "surname", "mail",
                       "userPrincipalName", "employeeId").toPandas()

upn        = entra_all["userPrincipalName"].fillna("").str.lower()
is_deleted = upn.str.startswith("deleted_") | entra_all["displayName"].fillna("").str.lower().str.startswith("deleted_")
keep = upn.str.endswith(INTERNAL_DOMAIN) & ~upn.str.contains("#ext#")
if REQUIRE_EMPLOYEE_ID:
    keep &= entra_all["employeeId"].notna()
if not MATCH_DELETED_ACCOUNTS:
    keep &= ~is_deleted

entra = entra_all[keep].reset_index(drop=True)
entra["deleted"] = is_deleted[keep].values
print(f"Entra users: {len(entra_all)} total | {len(entra)} kept after filtering")

def norm(s):
    s = re.sub(r"[^a-z\s]", " ", str(s or "").lower())
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", s).strip()

def clean_display(s):
    s = re.sub(r"^deleted_", "", str(s or ""), flags=re.I)
    s = re.sub(r"\(.*?\)", " ", s)              # (PADS), (She / Her), (New Starter), (Administrator)
    s = s.strip(" ,")
    if "," in s:                                  # "Surname, First" -> "First Surname"
        last, first = [x.strip() for x in s.split(",", 1)]
        s = f"{first} {last}"
    return norm(s)

def index(keys):
    idx = {}
    for k, uid in zip(keys, entra["id"]):
        if k:
            idx.setdefault(k, []).append(uid)
    return idx

by_display = index(entra["displayName"].map(clean_display))
by_name    = index((entra["givenName"].fillna("") + " " + entra["surname"].fillna("")).map(norm))
by_upn     = index(entra["userPrincipalName"].fillna("").str.lower())
by_mail    = index(entra["mail"].fillna("").str.lower())
ENTRA_BY_ID = entra.set_index("id")

# Build outputs
# Every name gets a User row:
#   matched in Entra -> idpUserId = Entra object id
#   not matched      -> legacyId  = name as it appears in the source, idpUserId null
# User.id is a deterministic GUID, so reruns produce the same ids
import uuid
NS = uuid.UUID("5a62a000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001")

def user_key(r):
    return f"entra:{r.entraId}" if pd.notna(r.entraId) else f"legacy:{norm(r['name'])}"

name_map["key"] = name_map.apply(user_key, axis=1)
name_map["id"]  = name_map["key"].map(lambda k: str(uuid.uuid5(NS, k)).upper())

first = name_map.drop_duplicates("key")
unmatched_name = first["name"].where(first["entraId"].isna())
user_table = pd.DataFrame({
    "id":        first["id"],
    "idpUserId": first["entraId"].fillna(unmatched_name) if UNMATCHED_NAME_IN_IDP else first["entraId"],
    "legacyId":  None if UNMATCHED_NAME_IN_IDP else unmatched_name,
})

if MIGRATION_USER_UPN:
    hits = by_upn.get(MIGRATION_USER_UPN.lower(), [])
    if len(hits) != 1:
        raise ValueError(f"MIGRATION_USER_UPN not found in Entra: {MIGRATION_USER_UPN}")
    MIGRATION_USER_ID = str(uuid.uuid5(NS, f"entra:{hits[0]}")).upper()
    if MIGRATION_USER_ID not in set(user_table["id"]):
        user_table.loc[len(user_table)] = [MIGRATION_USER_ID, hits[0], None]
    print(f"MIGRATION_USER_ID = {MIGRATION_USER_ID}  (same in every env)")

# Review copy with names and emails, for sign-off only (not imported)
user_review = (name_map[["name", "id", "entraId", "method", "foundIn"]]
               .merge(entra[["id", "displayName", "mail"]].rename(columns={"id": "entraId"}),
                      on="entraId", how="left"))

# Lookup the schema notebook reads (USERS_FILE): every name now has an id
users_lookup = name_map[["id", "name"]]

print(f"User rows: {len(user_table)} | Entra-linked: {first.entraId.notna().sum()} "
      f"| name only: {first.entraId.isna().sum()}")

# Write outputs
def write_csv(pdf, path):
    mssparkutils.fs.put(f"{ROOT}/{path}", pdf.to_csv(index=False), True)
    print(f"Wrote {len(pdf):>4} rows -> {path}")

write_csv(user_table,   f"{OUTPUT_DIR}/User.csv")
write_csv(user_review,  f"{OUTPUT_DIR}/User_review.csv")
write_csv(unmatched,    "OUTPUT/VALIDATION/USERS/unmatched_users.csv")
write_csv(users_lookup, f"{REFERENCE_DIR}/users.csv")
